7.10 Multicore Distribution
The PduR module is distributed over all partitions and acts as a central inter-partition
dispatcher for any inter-partition (inter-core) routing path(s), mainly for gateway and
multicast use cases.
For further explanations about the distribution principles, please see chapter "Com-
Stack Distribution" within the [8, Guide to BSW Distribution].
